name: Dealing With Pain
overview: Scripture reveals that God is intimately near to those who suffer, offering healing and comfort to the brokenhearted and contrite in spirit, as seen in Psalms 34:18 and 147:3. The believer’s pain is not unnoticed; Jesus Himself bore our griefs and sorrows, affirming the depth of God's identification with human suffering (Isaiah 53:4). In our weakness and distress, we are encouraged to seek the Lord’s mercy and healing (Psalms 6:2), trusting in His sovereign power to bring about peace and restoration, for with God nothing is impossible (Luke 1:37). Furthermore, God’s plans for His people are rooted in hope and a future of peace, assuring us that our trials have a purposeful end (Jeremiah 29:11).
